fuel_consumption.source_quote: As of December 31, 2023, we hedged approximately 30% of our projected fuel requirements for 2024. Based on gallons expected to be consumed in 2023, for every one cent increase in the cost of a gallon of jet fuel, our fuel expense would result in approximately $3.0 million in additional annual fuel expense.

instrument_type_details.notes: Fuel derivative contracts (crude oil call options). Not designated as ASC 815 hedges. FV net asset $2.1M at Dec 31 2023. 90,258 thousand gallons (= 90.258M gallons) settling December 2024, covering ~30% of projected 2024 fuel requirements.

warnings: 90,258 gallons (thousands) from position table; 30% pct from item7a text
